newsitem.title: UK: Tate & Lyle up after Capel recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Tate & Lyle up after Capel recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Tate & Lyle Plc rose to a six-month high on Tuesday as analysts at HSBC James Capel repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.
Sources said the Capel recommendation came after a U.S. rival agreed a huge anti-trust settlement and as tumbling wheat prices promised to boost profit margins at the sugar producer.
Tate & Lyle shares were up 8p at 496-1/2 by 1358 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 498p -- their highest since April.
Analysts at Capel were not immediately available for comment.
On Monday Archer Daniels Midland Co, which competes with Tate's Staley unit, agreed to plead guilty to federal charges related to price-fixing and to pay fines totalling $100 million.
